runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification; touching timestamps is not verification. Existing records remain active when a new sweep does not rediscover them; absence from search is not deactivation evidence.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Work-schedule burden normalizer
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: Normalize schedule patterns such as 3-shift, rotating evenings/weekends, short-long week and fixed daytime into a comparable burden score. This prevents attractive title/pay matches from ranking too high when their real weekly schedule is materially worse than standard daytime work.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Stale refresh detector
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: Detect job-board listings whose update date changes while title, employer, requirements and canonical content remain effectively unchanged. Mark these as refreshed-old rather than genuinely fresh so <24h priority and alerts do not repeatedly surface recycled vacancies.
